summary: Parked kerb beside an overgrown empty lot, with flats 15-20 m off.
reasons: Overgrown vacant lot on own side

best_section.where: East kerb of Mitre Street, beside the overgrown vacant lot about 50 m from the top end

drivers.seclusion: Vacant, overgrown lot on the kerb side; nearest flats 15 m further down and a house about 20 m across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Cars park along both kerbs; room for a van in the line, but the street is narrow.
drivers.traffic: Quiet dead-end style side street with local traffic only.
drivers.convention: Weekday 1P and 2P signs; cars park along the street overnight, so a van blends in.

flags: Steep: about 4.5% grade in the best section, 8.6% max on the stretch
Busy road noise at the north end
sun_shade: Open from the east where the lot is clear; tree canopy shades the south end and the opposite side.
cannot_judge: Whether the vacant lot is fenced or about to be built on
